title: GCP-OASE & Scion: Team-Based, Provenance-Locked Pre-Clinical R&D on Google Cloud

scenes.title: Why Single-Player Chatbot Science Fails Governance
scenes.ssml: <speak>Welcome to the Google Cloud Scion and <say-as interpret-as="characters">OASE</say-as> Workshop, the Open Agentic Science Engine. Standard drug discovery pipelines and single-player chatbots break under pharma governance: rigid workflows drop targets when bulk omics surprises them, while unguarded models hallucinate metrics, drop negative caveats, and reinforce single-vendor blind spots.</speak>
scenes.voiceover: Welcome to the Google Cloud Scion and O.A.S.E. Workshop, the Open Agentic Science Engine. Standard drug discovery pipelines and single-player chatbots break under pharma governance: rigid workflows drop targets when bulk omics surprises them, while unguarded models hallucinate metrics, drop negative caveats, and reinforce single-vendor blind spots.

scenes.title: Scion + OASE Value Proposition & Multi-Model Projects
scenes.ssml: <speak>Google Cloud Scion and the Science Engine replace isolated chatbots with team-based, multi-model discovery. Scion's central Hub coordinates shared Projects across Gemini Enterprise, Antigravity, and the C-L-I. Model-agnostic Harnesses let Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI cross-check each other, while Scion's suspended phase pauses and resumes sessions across multi-week wet-lab C-R-O assays.</speak>
scenes.voiceover: Google Cloud Scion and the Science Engine replace isolated chatbots with team-based, multi-model discovery. Scion's central Hub coordinates shared Projects across Gemini Enterprise, Antigravity, and the CLI. Model-agnostic Harnesses let Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI cross-check each other, while Scion's suspended phase pauses and resumes sessions across multi-week wet-lab CRO assays.

scenes.title: 4-Tier Agent Roster, 9-State Work Orders & Two-Phase Latch
scenes.ssml: <speak>Inside each Scion Project, twenty-two specialized templates separate governance authority, operations, eight domain specialists, and independent reviewers on a push-only message bus. Specialists never judge raw data in prose: every tool runs in two phases, writing immutable files with S-H-A two-fifty-six sidecars before computing offline verdicts against thirty-six versioned threshold sets.</speak>

scenes.title: Stages 0-1: Hypothesis Tournament & Human Genetics (WO-001..003)
scenes.ssml: <speak>Now let's watch this architecture run our oral P-C-S-K-9 campaign live in Argolis. In Stages zero and one, the Science Engine ingests a twenty-eight match Co-Scientist <phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="ˈiːloʊ">Elo</phoneme> tournament at sixteen forty-two, confirms Nomad loss-of-function tolerance and OpenTargets familial hypercholesterolemia association at zero point eight six, and forces mandatory toxicology relays forward.</speak>

scenes.title: Stages 2-4: Allosteric Co-Folding & Catching the hERG Trap (WO-004..007)
scenes.ssml: <speak>In Stages two through four, AlphaFold three and F-pocket confirm a druggable allosteric groove at zero point six eight, and AutoDock Vina scores candidate A-zero-two at minus nine point four kilocalories per mole. Where a chatbot would declare victory, the Science Engine flags A-zero-two for three <phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="ˈædmɛt">ADMET</phoneme> and <phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="hɜːrɡ">hERG</phoneme> alerts, pivots to polar oxadiazole A-zero-three, and nominates candidate zero-one-four for once-daily oral dosing.</speak>
scenes.voiceover: In Stages 2 through 4, AlphaFold 3 and fpocket confirm a druggable allosteric groove at 0.68, and AutoDock Vina scores candidate A02 at -9.4 kcal/mol. Where a chatbot would declare victory, the Science Engine flags A02 for 3 ADMET and hERG alerts, pivots to polar oxadiazole A03, and nominates candidate 014 for once-daily oral dosing.

scenes.title: Mechanical Governance Teeth: 4 Adversarial Tamper Drills
scenes.ssml: <speak>Next, we test the mechanical teeth of Dual Validation. Every work order must pass ten deterministic provenance, citation, threshold, and relay checks before the Science Program Lead can promote it. Across four adversarial drills, flipping a file byte, inflating a docking score, deleting a disorder caveat, or stripping a threshold set immediately halts promotion.</speak>

scenes.title: The Complete Picture & 31-Page Stage-Gate Dossier (WO-008)
scenes.ssml: <speak>In our final stage, the Project Curator compiles all eight validated work orders and eleven mandatory relays into a thirty-one page Static Evidence Portal and candidate nomination dossier. Every claim in the regulatory narrative resolves within one percent of its underlying S-H-A two-fifty-six artifact on Google Cloud.</speak>

scenes.title: Architecture Scorecard & Field Takeaways
scenes.ssml: <speak>Running this full campaign live in Argolis confirms our core architectural takeaway: mechanical latches cannot replace physical wet-lab biology, but combining Google Cloud Scion's multi-model projects with the Science Engine's provenance gates eliminates silent narrative drift and makes agentic discovery auditable.</speak>
